title: fix(pm): dispatch-gates ui/scripts suite roots cover the whole ui tree
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_
Fixes #37254

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:开发代理改动界面包里任何文件(包括各包自带的脚本目录)时,派发门禁清单现在会提示它先跑界面脚本测试套件。
- 属于车队开发效率治理,替那些因清单漏报、等 CI 才发现界面测试变红的开发代理解决问题。
- 若出错,最坏是界面改动多跑一次约五分钟的测试套件,或继续漏报;只改一张数据表,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- `UI_SCRIPTS_SUITE_ROOTS` in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` is widened from five sub-tree roots (`ui/packages/**/src`, `ui/packages/**/src/**`, `ui/apps/**`, `skills/objectui/**`, `ui/scripts/**`) to `ui`, `ui/**` and `skills/objectui/**`. The row's `kind` and `why` prose follow.
- **Widen, not derive** — the reading on origin/main 93fa9118:
  - `ui/scripts/check-ui-root-lookups.mjs` walks `SCAN_ROOTS = ['scripts', 'packages', 'apps']` under the ui root, with no exclusion for a package's own `scripts/` directory, and `check-ui-root-lookups.test.ts` runs that scan (`scan(repoRoot)`, `scanned > 100`). Six such directories exist today (`components`, `fields`, `i18n`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`).
  - Files under `ui/scripts/` and `ui/scripts/__tests__/` that name each top-level ui directory: `packages` 210, `scripts` 239, `apps` 121, `docs` 58, `examples` 53, `e2e` 26, `eslint-rules` 13, `patches` 8. Ui root files: `package.json` 144, `.changeset` 36, `tsconfig.json` 35, `vitest.config.mts` 32, `eslint.config.js` 15, `playwright.config.ts` 4.
  - So the suite reads every top-level part of the ui tree. Building the list from what the suite reads would mean parsing about 180 tests' read sites, and it would still end up at roughly `ui/**`. CI's own `ui` path filter in `ci.yml` is `ui/**` too. Including the few unread root files (`cliff.toml`, `.gitattributes`) costs one extra suite run. Leaving a reader out costs a red CI round trip.
- The old control `ui/packages/core/package.json` ("outside the roots") was wrong: `package-files-exist.test.ts` reads every ui package manifest. It is now a specimen.

## Tests

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: specimens are now keyed by the reader that makes them suite inputs. New ones are `ui/packages/components/scripts/new-script.mjs` (the card's miss), `ui/packages/core/package.json` and `ui/vitest.config.mts`. Each one is checked through the predicate, the whole table and the runnable union. The directory case now covers `ui/packages/fields/scripts` and bare `ui`. A `uikit/...` control checks that the `ui` root does not over-match on a shared prefix.
- Reverse check: run against the old five roots, `readByUiScriptsSuite` returns `false` for all three new specimens, so the new cases fail on the pre-fix list.

<details><summary>Self-test and Done-when readings at 20a777d0</summary>

```
✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2369 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred.
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
  ✓ a path under a ui package's own scripts/ directory is read by the ui/scripts suite (ui/packages/components/scripts/new-script.mjs)
  ✓ through the whole table, a diff under a ui package's own scripts/ directory derives the suite, anchored on the delimiter
  ✓ CONTROL: uikit/packages/core/scripts/x.mjs is outside the roots

node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands ui/packages/components/scripts/build-css.mjs   -> exit 0, prints: pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/
old roots: ui/packages/components/scripts/new-script.mjs false · ui/packages/core/package.json false · ui/vitest.config.mts false
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The slow tier of the self-test (`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`) is not measured locally. It runs longer than the foreground limit, so CI runs the full battery.
- Ran locally, all exit 0: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations` and its census, `check-declaration-mirrors`, `check-self-test-wired`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check-published-list-mirrors`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, plus the fast self-test. This is a declared narrowing: `--ran` reports 54 of 63 derived families unrun, and those are left to CI.
- Read first: (1) `UI_SCRIPTS_SUITE_ROOTS` and its docblock in `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`, the riskiest hunk because a wider root changes every ui card's gate list; (2) the specimen and control tables in the self-test.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands ui/packages/components/scripts/build-css.mjs | grep 'vitest run scripts/'` should print `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`. On main it prints nothing.
